facts.fact: 睡得太安稳的后果：计划需要修订。
facts.anchor: That meant I would have to revise my plan.

facts.fact: 修订版名单：Gunnar/Ivar/Astrid 三人可以活——「我不算不讲理」。
facts.anchor: Fine. Three Blackwoods could survive the purge. I wasn't unreasonable.

facts.fact: 他的整洁被记入加分项：乱放的鞋会让她摔断脖子。
facts.anchor: My husband was neat. That was useful.

facts.fact: 演弱的成本清单：每步要像自然、每次偏头要不精准。
facts.anchor: Being underestimated was hard fucking work.

facts.fact: 感官烹饪课上她忘了装无能——第一次。
facts.anchor: I'd completely forgotten to be incompetent.

facts.fact: 妯娌互怼现场：没有恶意，只有笑。
facts.anchor: There wasn't any malice in the room. Only laughter.

facts.fact: 她的空缺：不知道怎么信任「知道你软肋却选择不捅」的人。
facts.anchor: How to trust that someone could know exactly where you were vulnerable and choose, deliberately, not to hurt you.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 收尾：这家的女人都有锋利的脑子和更锋利的舌头——你大概会融进来。
facts.anchor: I suspect you'll fit right in.
